To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have derived general equations describing the influence of oscillatory magnetic field on the spin evolution of a particle in storage rings.

1. the influence of oscillation of the horizontal field on the spin motion in storage ring is considered; 2. the influence of the oscillations of the horizontal field is considered for arbitrary initial polarization; 3. the general equations describing the spin evolution in the presence of the horizontal oscillating field are derived; 4. the general spin motion in storage-ring conditioned by the vertical betatron oscillation is considered; 5. the spin motion in the presence of oscillating vertical field

the spin evolution in the horizontal plane of a storage ring with an oscillating horizontal magnetic field is described by two coupled differential equations, one of which describes the evolution of the vertical polarization component and the other one describes the evolution of a combination of the horizontal and longitudinal components of the polarization.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the general theoretical description of spin evolution in storage ring in presence of oscillation horizontal fields.
the influence of the oscillating horizontal magnetic field on spin motion in storage ring.
the general theoretical description of spin motion under the influence of horizontal oscillating magnetic field in storage rings.

the general theory of the influence of the oscillating horizontal fields on the spin motion in storage ring is developed.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have derived a general theoretical description of spin evolution in storage ring in presence of oscillation magnetic fields.
the spin motion in storage ring in presence of oscillation magnetic and quasistatic magnetic field is considered.

we have derived general equations for the spin motion in storage ring, which can be used in all cases of oscillating horizontal and vertical fields, when these fields are nonresonant and when the initial spin orientation is arbitrary.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the spin evolution in the presence of oscillating vertical betatron motion is not described by a single equation for the spin component in the direction of the vertical betatron oscillation but by three coupled equations.
the spin motion in presence of oscillation fields is described by two equations for the components of the polarization along and across the oscillation plane.
the spin motion in storage ring is conditioned by the oscillating fields in a very non-trivial way.
